observed: One common full-map firmware produced three exact causal phase bitmaps: unchanged public32 negative 0x04 (no autonomous event; old bit1 hook works), OR control 0x15 (autonomous event and old hook both work), and production 0x11 (autonomous event repeats after reset; old hook inert). Every run had FCB=0x000f0002, every non-status error group zero, counter seen=0xff, observations=8, final words [0x4147414d,0,0,0], cleanup reset, and no flash command. Production repeated three sequential times.
status_contract: Reset synchronously arms one event. The existing free-running three-bit public counter reaches 7 without any MCU AHB write; count==7 and armed generate one HCLK-synchronous set pulse, armed then clears and stays low, STATUS retains the event, W1C bit0 clears it without reassertion, reset dominates and re-arms a second event, and the old AHB bit1 qualification hook is inert in production.
controls: The base, OR-control and production image hashes are mode-bound. The checker pins the two added BELs/functions, all three counter inputs, armed feedback/reset/clock, exact six-item old-hook pruning only in production, append-only shared trees, preservation of the public32 map, unique BEL/wire ownership, and zero selector debt.
scope: One exact AGRV2KL48/L48 HSE=8 SYSCLK=10 composition proving an autonomous HCLK-synchronous fabric source can drive the qualified W1C ingress. It is not a generic user-net STATUS_SET socket, arbitrary application overlay, asynchronous event, pulse-width/CDC guarantee, interrupt controller, event ABI, arbitrary placement/width, other package/device, full-window/burst/signed/misaligned access, or generic register-bank generator.
consequence: The exact public32 map now has a selectable, reproducible profile whose W1C status is set by fabric activity with no software-set write or GPIO/package-pin stimulus, while the complete ID/scratch/counter/read/reset matrix remains qualified.
next_experiment: Build a preserved-core overlay/status socket that lets arbitrary user RTL bind a reviewed synchronous STATUS_SET net without replacing the hash-pinned public32 core; keep asynchronous CDC and interrupt semantics separate.
